checks.result: Single-night F24 cannot prove continuous stay. ES uses offer summaries for candidates; Java checks the fixed nightly table. Pages is tutorial only; reader does not build frontend or booking flows.

Hotel local Asia/Shanghai LocalDate [checkIn,checkOut); Nov1->3 is two nights. o01 Nov3 sold-out does not block checkout Nov3, but blocks checkout Nov4. No UTC millisecond/24-hour arithmetic or now-dependent fixtures.

Same offer/hotel/room/plan/currency for all requested nights. capacity and adultsPerRoom are per room; stock must meet requested rooms every night; integer minor currency per room/night; total budget covers all rooms/nights. o02 cannot borrow h02/o11's alternate room.

window bounds are date extrema and max_available_rooms is max over the table, including non-saleable rows. Necessary-only predicates rely on a complete same-version snapshot. min_price_minor is not used as the actual total or an unsafe budget cap. USD/capacity1/paused/date-start counterexamples excluded in candidate query.

Missing date/price reject, zero stock differs from missing date, stock1 fails rooms2, arrival-only minimum stay is explicitly a teaching rule. o01's second date min_stay_arrival5 is not applied to a Nov1 arrival. Duplicate offer/date rejected at load. CTA/CTD, children, taxes, fees and live supply remain outside scope.

Default 8 candidates: accepted o01 70000/o04 65000/o10 90000 fen; five distinct rejection reasons. Two rooms: o01 140000/o10 180000; three nights: o04 95000/o05 75000/o06 140000/o10 135000; one night: seven accepted. Candidate order is offer_id, not price order or hotel ranking.

Full candidate builder, date expansion, first rejection, long exact arithmetic, identity/source equality and complete-result guards appear in prose from actual files. Input dates/constraints and 400/502/503 mappings linked or shown. Invalid metadata is an integrity failure, not ordinary business unavailability. Budget-exceeded may show complete calculated price; other rejects show no partial total.

Formal round1/round2 each have cleanup, 21 teaching plus29 extra HTTP. Typed null score omission is the only REST comparison normalization. Full DSL, hits/source/sort/total, nightly fields and hand-coded ID/reason/amount expectations checked. 109total/100returned and snapshot mismatch produce502 and recover.

Seven-section structure, 880px column, 7 folded exercises, 3 pitfalls, two theme-generated D2 with source and full-view links. F24 changes only next-course prose/link. F26 remains unimplemented; no collapse, hotel count, global cheapest-stay or realtime booking claims.
